title: Opening a part sale never asks the over-credit question
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure customer A holds Net 30, has a credit limit of $500.00 and unpaid invoices totalling $600.00.
  • Start on Parts, Part Sales.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Part Sale".
  2. Pick customer A as the customer.
  3. Confirm the New Part Sale window.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Part Sale window opens.

Step 2:

  • The window shows customer A as the customer.

Step 3:

  • No over-credit confirmation opens (as before the release).
  • The new part sale opens and shows the "Over limit" badge.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11678 (Story 9, Over Credit warning)

  • S9-R4: “Opening a part sale shows no over-credit confirmation, as today; for part sales only the 'Over limit' badge follows S9-R1.”
  • S9-R2: “The "Over limit" badge on work orders and part sales follows the same rule as S9-R1.”
